set.body:
Owns scanpath-multimatch and fixation-overlap-and-transport. Existing Scanpath/Alignment/MultiMatch/Transport and the Python multimatch_gaze fixtures are useful implementation evidence; they are not measurements of eyesim.

1. Pin scanpath, scanpath_similarity and multi_match via exported R calls on the selected non-square three-point paths: component names/order, screen-size and duration normalization, alignment, minimum cardinality, ties, window filtering, empty/short/degenerate paths and component failures. Keep Python evidence separately identified. eyesim's sixth position-EMD component is covered only by a measured intentional divergence consistent with the no-exact-EMD decision on eyesim-compare; do not implement a hidden exact solver or substitute a five-component claim.
2. Build fixation_overlap using the shared eyesim-sampling trajectory primitive. Pin strict distance < threshold (including exact equality), Euclidean/Manhattan distance, time units and query grid. The direct entry point defaults to threshold 60 and a 20-unit grid ending at max(x$onset); similarity.fixation_group defaults to threshold 40 and requires explicit time_samples. The denominator includes requested queries even when distance is missing. Preserve that reference result while making the native missing-support policy explicit.
3. Pin fixation_similarity/Sinkhorn spatial and onset scaling, time weight, duration-normalized masses, lambda and backend algorithm, convergence/degenerate failures, and the reference 1/(1+d) output transform. Existing spatial Transport.sinkhorn is not automatically the same spatiotemporal estimand. Distinguish raw transport cost, debiased divergence and similarity without a false metric claim.

Acceptance: analytic component/threshold/transport cases plus locked reference fixtures, public portable APIs, no silent row/component loss, and truthful availability errors. Full closure depends on eyesim-sampling; component-only measurement can start independently. Exact EMD reference evidence is shared with eyesim-compare.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Pin basic scanpath and fixation-pattern conformance
